title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - DigitalIdentity
description: DigitalIdentity is a class that allow to describe a digital identity for an individual or a resource or a specific party role. One of these three MUST be provided. If an individual is provided, this identity will be for all her/his partyRole. To avoid confusion it is recommended in this case to not provide partyRoleIdentified. (TM Forum TMF720 Digital Identity Management 4.0.0, Swagger definition DigitalIdentity; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:DigitalIdentity:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'DigitalIdentity'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF720_DigitalIdentity/blob/v4.0.0/TMF720-DigitalIdentity-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/DigitalIdentity/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:DigitalIdentity:<tmfId>. unique identifier

creationDate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF720_DigitalIdentity/blob/v4.0.0/TMF720-DigitalIdentity-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/DigitalIdentity/properties/creationDate'. Date and time of the Digital Identity creation (timestamp)

lastUpdate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF720_DigitalIdentity/blob/v4.0.0/TMF720-DigitalIdentity-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/DigitalIdentity/properties/lastUpdate'. Date and time of the Digital Identity last update (timestamp)

nickname.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF720_DigitalIdentity/blob/v4.0.0/TMF720-DigitalIdentity-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/DigitalIdentity/properties/nickname'. Nickname associated to this digital identity (like Juanito17 or the QuebecMoose etc...).

status.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF720_DigitalIdentity/blob/v4.0.0/TMF720-DigitalIdentity-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/DigitalIdentity/properties/status'. Used to indicate the current lifecycle status of this digital identity (unknown, active, suspended, archived).

attachment.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF720_DigitalIdentity/blob/v4.0.0/TMF720-DigitalIdentity-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/DigitalIdentity/properties/attachment'. List of attachment associated with this digital identity. Could be use to link a cute cat or moose picture to a digital identity for example.

contactMedium.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF720_DigitalIdentity/blob/v4.0.0/TMF720-DigitalIdentity-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/DigitalIdentity/properties/contactMedium'. List of contact medium associated with the digital identity.

credential.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF720_DigitalIdentity/blob/v4.0.0/TMF720-DigitalIdentity-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/DigitalIdentity/properties/credential'. A list of credential/authentification method that are used for this digital identity.

individualIdentified.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF720_DigitalIdentity/blob/v4.0.0/TMF720-DigitalIdentity-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/DigitalIdentity/properties/individualIdentified'. Individual identified by this digital identity. In this case the digitial identity is for all her/his role. It is recommended to not provide partyRoleIdentified if individualIdentified provided

partyRoleIdentified.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF720_DigitalIdentity/blob/v4.0.0/TMF720-DigitalIdentity-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/DigitalIdentity/properties/partyRoleIdentified'. Related Parties who are identified by this digital identity.

relatedParty.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF720_DigitalIdentity/blob/v4.0.0/TMF720-DigitalIdentity-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/DigitalIdentity/properties/relatedParty'. Parties who have an interest in this digital identity (like the organization in charge of providing identity). This is NOT the party identified by this digital identity.

resourceIdentified.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF720_DigitalIdentity/blob/v4.0.0/TMF720-DigitalIdentity-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/DigitalIdentity/properties/resourceIdentified'. Resource identified by this digital identity. It is recommended to no provided individualIdentified or partyRoleIdentified if resourceIdentified provided. In TMF this is a ResourceRef object; here the NGSI-LD id of the referenced Resource entity (urn:ngsi-ld:Resource:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

validFor.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF720_DigitalIdentity/blob/v4.0.0/TMF720-DigitalIdentity-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/DigitalIdentity/properties/validFor'. The period for which this digial identity is valid.

tmfBaseType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF720_DigitalIdentity/blob/v4.0.0/TMF720-DigitalIdentity-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/DigitalIdentity/properties/@baseType'. Renamed from TMF '@baseType' (JSON-LD keyword). When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

tmfSchemaLocation.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF720_DigitalIdentity/blob/v4.0.0/TMF720-DigitalIdentity-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/DigitalIdentity/properties/@schemaLocation'. Renamed from TMF '@schemaLocation' (JSON-LD keyword). A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

tmfType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF720_DigitalIdentity/blob/v4.0.0/TMF720-DigitalIdentity-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/DigitalIdentity/properties/@type'. Renamed from TMF '@type' (JSON-LD keyword). TMF class name of the instance: 'DigitalIdentity' or a sub-class / extension name. When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class Extensible name
